MediaPipe Tasks Vision, version 0.10.21
Copyright Google LLC and contributors. Library license: Apache-2.0.
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/v/0.10.21
https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe

Unmodified npm library bundles and WASM files are included here for local inference.
vision_bundle.js is the original vision_bundle.cjs with a .js filename; vision-worker.js supplies an exports object.

Model sources (Google MediaPipe official prebuilt models):
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_lite/float16/1/pose_landmarker_lite.task
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task
See the official MediaPipe model cards for model details and applicable terms.
